# AMD FidelityFX SDK headers

`api/include/ffx_api.h`, `api/include/ffx_api_types.h`, `api/include/dx12/ffx_api_dx12.h` and `upscalers/include/ffx_upscale.h` are unmodified copies from AMD's FidelityFX SDK
(https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/FidelityFX-SDK), Copyright (C) 2026 Advanced Micro Devices, Inc., under the MIT license printed at the top of
each file. They are needed only to build the DLL.
